rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the single fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item or the schedule column/row. Amounts print the writer's official text (1,234.56) in one text cell. The TIN boxes, the Item 11 specification (an option code), the Schedule 1 industry description and the Schedule 4/5 formula operands are not fillable cells on this sheet. Schedule rows beyond those printed (4 for Schedules 1-3, 5 for Schedules 6-8) belong on attached sheets. Booleans fill X in the box left of the printed option. Since #113 every value the print map carries has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
